name: Transactional Interpretation (TI)
one_line: The Transactional Interpretation views a quantum event as the result of a 'transaction' between an emitter and an absorber.

math_relation_to_SQM.equations_summary: TI uses the standard wave mechanics of SQM but provides a physical story for the mathematical formalism, particularly for the Born rule |Ψ|². It gives a real, physical meaning to the advanced solutions of relativistic wave equations, which are usually discarded.

key_claims: Any quantum emission involves both a retarded wave (Ψ) moving forward in time and an advanced wave (Ψ*) moving backward in time.
